name: Factorial
summary: Factorial is an HR platform whose pricing page says it starts at $8 per user per month. Every plan includes Factorial Core, with an employee directory, onboarding, document sending and e-signature. Time Off and other modules are add-ons whose prices are not listed.

facts.text: Time Off, Time Tracking, Performance, Shift Management, Recruitment and several other modules are add-ons to Factorial Core, and the pricing page lists no prices for them.
The HR software page describes absence policies with request approval and downloadable reports based on company activity.
The pricing page shows the $8 figure with a dollar sign only and gives no currency code, so the figure may differ by country.

plans.name: Starting price
plans.notes: Includes Factorial Core. Add-on modules and tailored quotes are priced separately

hiddenCosts: Add-on module prices, including Time Off, are not published.
The page does not state contract length, minimum commitment or trial terms.
